findings.detail: Framework and prior legal evidence records are reused with exact source, unit and fidelity hashes.
Eleven SRC-0010 units were checked for frontmatter, locator and native-text consistency; no raw source text is retained.
GDPR references support only personal-data processing routes and do not establish general data quality.
SRC-0010 groups two local PDF paths; the source SHA and unit lineage remain the controlling provenance identifiers.
